measurement_scope.audio_seconds_per_generation_second: source audio seconds / request-through-EOF seconds; higher is faster
measurement_scope.chunk_timing: client HTTP read observations; not server synthesis chunk boundaries
measurement_scope.end_to_end: HTTP request start through response EOF, excluding decoding and artifact writes
measurement_scope.first_audio: first observed HTTP read containing one complete audio frame; WAV headers excluded
measurement_scope.float_normalization: nonfinite float samples replaced with zero and reported as advisory
measurement_scope.generation_seconds_per_audio_second: request-through-EOF seconds / source audio seconds; lower is faster
measurement_scope.normalization: whole-response linear interpolation to configured mono PCM16 rate; no anti-aliasing filter
measurement_scope.upstream_buffering: stream-requested; HTTP reads may still be buffered
measurement_scope.warm_wall: warm replay wall time includes HTTP, decoding, resampling, fsync, artifact hashing and screening; not endpoint throughput
